about:
Arctic Restaurant Service & Supply has operated from Madisonville, Kentucky since 1973. The company was founded as a family-owned business and remains under family ownership today, serving the western Kentucky region and surrounding areas.

The company supplies commercial cooking equipment, refrigeration systems, and a full range of restaurant supplies including cookware and tableware. It carries major brands such as Vulcan, Duke, Blodgett, Henny Penny, True Manufacturing, Victory Refrigeration, and Delfield. Beyond sales, Arctic provides installation, planned maintenance, 24/7 emergency repair, and a parts department that stocks inventory and can special-order items typically within three to four business days. The business also rents refrigerated trailers for events and seasonal needs, and offers commercial HVAC services.

Arctic serves a broad spectrum of foodservice operations, from small cafes and catering outfits to large commercial kitchens in hotels, schools, and healthcare facilities. Its customer base includes restaurants, hotels, educational institutions, and medical centers across western Kentucky.

The company emphasizes its status as an authorized warranty provider for major brands, with factory-trained, licensed, and insured technicians. It differentiates itself through 24/7 emergency response, free delivery within a 60-mile radius for trailer rentals, and a local, family-owned presence spanning more than five decades.
